hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Analyze the product cost incurred whenever a cluster of size a + b divides into parts a and b.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Observe that the sum of pairwise products across all splits is invariant under partition choice.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Evaluate the total cost directly as n multiplied by n minus one divided by two.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct formula evaluation takes constant time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive splitting simulation does redundant work since the total cost is an algebraic invariant.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Scalar arithmetic avoids recursive state memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes combinatorial invariant that sum of products equals n choose 2.
